en.t: The storage room had already grown dim.

units.source_text: 母亲将明凑近我的耳边，这位"慈母"的汗味儿就在我的四周飘逸。

en.t: Mother brought Ming close to my ear, and the smell of sweat from this "loving mother" drifted all around me.

units.source_text: 我还记得这时母亲笑了。

en.t: I still remember that at that moment Mother laughed.

units.source_text: 浅黑色的乳房的回想这种心象，多么不愉快地在我的心中翻腾。

en.t: That mental image, the recollection of darkish breasts, churned in my heart with such unpleasant force.

units.source_text: 点燃的卑微的野火，仿佛有一种肉体的强制力似的东西，使我感到恐惧万分。

en.t: The ignited, lowly wildfire seemed to possess something like a physical power of compulsion, filling me with terror.

units.source_text: 母亲的鬈曲鬓发触到我的脸颊时，

en.t: When Mother's curled hair at her temples touched my cheek,

units.source_text: 我看见一只蜻蜒落在黄昏笼罩的中院那长满青苔的洗手钟上，悠闲地憩息。

en.t: I saw a dragonfly settle on the moss-covered washbasin in the twilight-shrouded courtyard and rest there at ease.

units.source_text: 傍晚的天空在这小圆形的水面上落下了影子。

en.t: The evening sky cast its reflection on that small, round surface of water.
All around was silent, without a sound.

units.source_text: 这时候，鹿苑专简直成了无人的寺庙。

en.t: At that moment, Rokuon Temple had become almost a deserted temple.
